integrity: Algebraic proof includes an explicit binomial-kernel formula, implicit-function root derivative, alternating-sign argument and local root-count continuity. A standalone exact-rational checker provides finite supplementary tests, not a substitute for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is local in negative beta for each fixed integer \(\alpha=4k-2\) and concerns the odd parity projection. The scalar numerator root at zero cannot be attained by a pair of points on the punctured disk. Independent mathematical validation and comprehensive historical-priority verification have not been performed.
title: Alternating boundary-zero entry and exact local counts for odd weighted Bergman kernels
